scope: real isolated PostgreSQL 17 with Supabase Auth/Storage schema contracts
checks: idempotent seed does not duplicate history
anonymous public RPC sees published only
ordinary authenticated user is not admin
ordinary user cannot inspect private image references
RLS hides drafts from ordinary user

new draft does not appear publicly
duplicate ID cannot overwrite an existing model
zero price rejected at database boundary

hidden model does not authorize new image reads
